findings.assessment: Broker ACL documentation mismatch, not an erroneous Java client authorization implementation. Apache explicitly says DESCRIBE GROUP is the correct permission. The default application uses local transport; the optional local demonstration broker is not a secured production installation. Production broker ACLs must be reviewed; changing client versions is not an ACL fix.
Wrong ecosystem CPE match: advisory affects @opentelemetry/core in JavaScript, not the io.opentelemetry Java API artifact. No JavaScript OpenTelemetry runtime is shipped by this application.

limitations: NVD/CPE matching is heuristic; passing a threshold does not prove absence of vulnerabilities.
No exploitation or real customer impact was observed or claimed.
No suppression was needed; the informational matches remain visible in reports.
